sourceFile: 32. TIU C11-20  Report Test  SPL JIG improve stuck sample date 13.1.2026_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The workbook is citeable, but the draft misidentifies the changed factor and includes unreliable extracted measurement statistics.
issues: Changed factor should be Normal vs new SPL TEST JIG, not Day shift vs Day shift/TOTAL TEST.
Primary outcome should emphasize Stuck JIG NG improvement, including total 0/8945 vs Normal 5/2724.
Daily SPL rows should not be treated as separate baseline comparisons against one Normal row without noting date mismatch.
Measurement outcome is invalid because stats are derived from header/mixed defect columns, not measurements.
Decision text partly conflicts with computed Normal total NG rate and needs cautious wording.
correctionPlan: Rewrite changed factor as jig condition: Normal vs new SPL TEST JIG for TIU C11-20L day shift.
Create a Stuck JIG defect outcome using rows Test!17-18, Test!27, Test!29, and decision Test!33.
Keep overall function NG rate as a secondary outcome using total SPL row and Normal row, with date/context limitation.
Remove the bogus measurement-stat outcome or recast defect-category counts only.
Cite title, purpose/content, headers, SPL total, Normal row, and decision rows.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient until regrouped around the actual jig-condition evidence.
